title: Squared lower-bound comparison
statement: Let $C,\delta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1\le C$, $0<\delta$, and $\delta\le 1/(10C)$. Then $1-\delta-16C^2\delta^2\log_2(1/(C\delta))\ge (1-\delta/2-2\eta(C,\delta))^2$, where $\eta(C,\delta)=16C^2\delta^2\max\{\log_2(1/(C\delta)),1\}$.
